p.bio: Jen-E started sailing at the age of 7 in the Optimist class and is currently a crew in the 49er class. Having sailed single handed dinghies such as the Opti, Byte and Laser, he competed for a year in the International 420 class, before taking a break from sailing dinghies. He was introduced to keelboat racing and competed on the SB20, J24, J70, J80, FE26, FE28R, SM40s and most recently the RS21, finishing 3rd in the Summer Universiade in 2019. Jen-E started sailing the 49er class in 2018 and finished 2nd at the 2022 Asian Sailing Championships. He is currently campaigning for the Asian Games and is also working full time as a coach to fund his sailing ambitions.
